question:
Who were the writers of 'Tawarikh' during the Delhi Sultanate period?

I. Administrators

II. Poets and courtiers
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The authors of **Tawarikh** (plural of **Tarikh**, meaning history) were learned men who played a significant role in the administration and intellectual life of the **Delhi Sultanate**.
 
• These authors included **administrators**, **secretaries**, **poets**, and **courtiers** who lived in **cities**, mainly **Delhi**, and rarely in villages. ***Hence, statement I is correct.***
 
• In addition to recording historical events, these **poets and courtiers** frequently advised the **Sultans** on matters of **governance** and the importance of maintaining a **just rule** based on specific social hierarchies. ***Hence, statement II is correct.***
